decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - It is considered that this application for the erection of a single storey side and rear extension and side and rear roof extension and a rooflight to front elevation  at 241 Jersey Road, because of the position, design and appearance of the extensions, would be acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics of  this property and would not be detrimental to the  appearance of the original dwellinghouse and the character of the 
street scene, to the amenities of the adjoining and neighbouring 
properties or the character of the Osterly Park Conservation  Area.  The development is in accordance with the UDP policies  ENV- B.1.1 (New Development), ENVB2.2 (Conservation Areas), ENVN 1.7  (Development near the Metropolitan Land Boundary), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and T 1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and 
Servicing facilities for Developments) of The London Borough of  Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003; and is  compliant with  Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 5 - The extensions  hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 241 Jersey Road.
Condition : 6 - The windows formed in the west elevation shall be obscure glazed, and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
description: Erection of a single storey side and rear extension and side & rear roof extensions and rooflight to front elevation of existing house.
